title: Sonar reveals Samabaj's submerged plaza
caption: Open the original Samabaj sonar figure: submerged plaza and stelae. This is instrument imagery, not an underwater photograph.
credit: Sonia Medrano / Proyecto Arqueológico Subacuático Atitlán / Asociación Tikal, 2011, Figure 2
limit: Report proposes approximately AD 300 inundation from ceramics, not a directly measured flooding year. Reuse license unverified; open the source to view the original.

title: The excavators' plan of submerged Samabaj
caption: Open the original excavators' plan of Samabaj. A documented inland lake settlement whose proposed Book of Mormon identity is unconfirmed.
credit: S. Medrano and A. Linares; E. Mencos / Proyecto Arqueológico Subacuático Atitlán, 2011, Figure 1
limit: Approximately AD 300 ceramic-based inundation interpretation; current standing water does not alone date the submergence. Reuse license unverified; open the source to view the original.
